title: Installation Guide
author: 5e8a
summary: Instructions on how to install and update Fabric Boosted using Modrinth App.
content:
## :DownloadIcon: Installing Modrinth App

To install [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app), download it from the official website and follow the installation instructions.

## :RocketIcon: Installing Fabric Boosted

Go to Discover content section in Modrinth App, and search for Fabric Boosted, and click Install.

## :ArrowsClockwiseIcon: Updating Fabric Boosted

To update Fabric Boosted, open Modrinth App, go to the Library tab, and click on Fabric Boosted instance, then click Update pack, if an update is available.

Make sure to check Minecraft version when updating the pack.

## :PushPinIcon: Versioning

Fabric Boosted uses X.Y.Z versioning scheme, where:

- **X** - Major Minecraft Updates (1.19, 1.20 etc.)
- **Y** - Minor Minecraft Updates (1.20.1, 1.20.2 etc.)
- **Z** - Fabric Boosted specific updates (mod updates, bug fixes etc.)

We also release Alpha and Beta versions named for example 2.6.0-Alpha5 or 2.6.0-Beta2

- **Beta** - Unstable Versions with some missing mods
- **Alpha** - Test Builds with many missing mods

title: Performance Tweaks
author: 5e8a
summary: Maximize your FPS by tweaking specific options and JVM settings.
content:
## :CpuIcon: Allocating more RAM

If you have enough system RAM, we recommend allocating between 4GB to 6GB of RAM.

To do this in Modrinth App, open your Fabric Boosted instance, go to Settings > Java and memory, select Custom memory allocation, and set desired amount of RAM.

| RAM | MB |
|-----|----|
| 2GB | 2048 MB |
| 4GB | 4096 MB |
| 6GB | 6144 MB |
| 8GB | 8192 MB |

## :TelevisionIcon: Video Settings

- **Render Distance** - Default is set to 12 chunks, you can lower it for better performance.
- **Simulation Distance** - Default is set to 12 chunks, you can lower it for better performance.
- **Graphics** - Set to Fast for optimal performance.
- **Smooth Lighting** - Turned off.
- **Particles** - Set to Decreased, you can change it to Minimal for better performance.
- **Clouds** - Turned off.
- **Entity Distance** - Set to 100%
- **V-Sync** - Turned off.
- **Entity Shadows** - Turned off.
- **Leaves** - Set to Fast.
- **Weather** - Set to Fast.

## :ImageIcon: Nvidium Mod

If you have an NVIDIA GPU (16 series or newer), Nvidium will keep more chunks loaded in GPU memory, improving experience while moving around world without losing performance.

Nvidium settings is located in Video Settings > Nvidium. Default is set to 256 Chunks, you can decrease it or completely disable it.

## :ScissorsIcon: More Culling mod

More Culling improves performance by not rendering objects that are not visible to the player, such as those blocked by other objects.

More Culling settings is located in Video Settings > More Culling.

## :WrenchIcon: Other Performance Mods

Fabric Boosted includes several performance enhancing mods such as:

- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - Optimization to game physics, mob AI
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - Reduces RAM usage
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - Stops rendering invisible entities
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) - Improves the immediate mode rendering performance
- [ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux) - Improves the performance of light updates
- [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton) - Optimizes networking stack
- [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix) - Improves performance, reduces memory usage, and fixes many bugs
- [Very Many Players](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric) - Improves game performance at high playercounts
- [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) - Improves chunk performance
- [Fast Noise](https://modrinth.com/mod/zfastnoise) - Optimises world generation performance
- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations) - Collection of mostly micro optimizations
- [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities) - Improves Block Entity Rendering

These mods work in the background to optimize various aspects of the game, providing a smoother experience without requiring any additional configuration.

title: Shaders Setup Guide
author: 5e8a
summary: Guide on how to download and enable shaders.
content:
## :NoteIcon: Introduction

[Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) is a mod that allows you to use shaders in Minecraft. Shaders enhance the visual quality of Minecraft by adding realistic lighting, shadows, and effects. This guide will help you download and enable shaders in Fabric Boosted.

## :GlobeIcon: Downloading Shaders

To download shaders go to Fabric Boosted Instance in Modrinth App, go to install content, switch to Shaders tab, and download Shader Pack of your choice.

If you want to install Shader Packs outside of Modrinth App, place the downloaded .zip file into the 'shaderpacks' folder.

You can find this folder by click three dots, then Open Folder > shaderpacks.

## :SparkleIcon: Enabling Shaders

To enable shaders, go to the Settings > Video Settings > Shaders Packs, and select a shader pack from the list and click Apply.

title: Adding Mods
author: 5e8a
summary: Instructions on how to add additional mods to Fabric Boosted.
content:
## :DeviceMobileIcon: Using Modrinth App

To add mods to Fabric Boosted, open the Modrinth App, select your Fabric Boosted instance, and navigate to the 'Install Content' tab. From there, you can browse and install mods directly from Modrinth.

> **Note:** Fabric Boosted will not update automatically added Mods, so make sure to check for updates manually.

## :FolderIcon: Manually Adding Mods

You can also add mods manually by placing the mod .jar files into the 'mods' folder of your Fabric Boosted instance.

To access this folder, open Modrinth App, select your Fabric Boosted instance, click on the three dots, and choose 'Open Folder' > 'mods'.

## :WarningIcon: Incompatible Mods

- VulkanMod
- OptiFabric
- Embeddium
- NoisiumForked

If you find any other incompatible mods, please report them on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/uaX8D5jQp2).

title: Quality of Life Mods
author: 5e8a
summary: Overview of Quality of Life mods included in Fabric Boosted.
content:
## :StarIcon: Quality of Life Mods

Fabric Boosted ships with a curated set of 22 Quality of Life mods that smooth out the rough edges of vanilla Minecraft - from better HUD information and chat tools to faster loading and crash recovery. Everything below is included out of the box, no setup required.

:carouselStart:
![Lighty light level overlay showing safe paths in a cave](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/lighty/caves.webp)
![Essential world hosting screen](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/essential/world-hosting.webp)
![Just Enough Items recipe GUI](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/jei/recipe-gui.webp)
![Shulker Box Tooltip full preview of container contents](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/shulker-box-tooltip/full-preview.webp)
![Smooth Skies skybox gradient at high render distance](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/smooth-skies/with.webp)
![Gamma Utils brightness comparison](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/gamma-utils/comparison.webp)
:carouselEnd:

### :ClipboardTextIcon: Quick Reference

| Mod | What it does |
|-----|--------------|
| [Appleskin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) | Food, hunger and saturation values |
| [Auth Me](https://modrinth.com/mod/auth-me) | In-game account authentication |
| [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby) | Render distance beyond the server's limit |
| [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads) | Player heads in chat messages |
| [Durability Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/durability-viewer-updated) | Armor durability on the HUD |
| [Don't Clear Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/dcch) | Chat history survives relogs |
| [Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential) | Friends, world hosting, skins & screenshots |
| [Fast Quit](https://modrinth.com/mod/fastquit) | Instant world saving in the background |
| [Gamma Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/gamma-utils) | Fullbright toggle |
| [Health Indicator TXF](https://modrinth.com/mod/health-indicator-txf) | Damage indicator on the HUD |
| [EpicForceCloseLoadingScreen](https://modrinth.com/mod/forcecloseworldloadingscreen) | Skips the loading terrain screen |
| [Lighty](https://modrinth.com/mod/lighty) | Light level overlay |
| [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports) | Makes chat unreportable |
| [Not Enough Crashes](https://modrinth.com/mod/notenoughcrashes) | Keep playing after a crash |
| [More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory) | Longer chat scrollback |
| [Ping View](https://modrinth.com/mod/ping-view) | Player ping in the tab list |
| [Remove Reloading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrls) | Resource packs load in the background |
| [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) | Item list and recipe viewer |
| [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) | Container contents in the tooltip |
| [Smooth Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-skies) | Smooth skybox colors |
| [Talk Balloons](https://modrinth.com/mod/talk-balloons) | Chat bubbles above players |
| [VoxelMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxelmap-updated) | Minimap, world map and waypoints |

### :GaugeIcon: HUD & Overlays

Mods that put useful information directly on your screen, so you never have to guess.

#### :AppleLogoIcon:  Appleskin

Ever wondered why your hunger bar has that flickering outline? Appleskin visualizes Minecraft's hidden food mechanics. Hold any food item to see exactly how much hunger and saturation it will restore, complete with a preview of how your hunger and health bars will change after eating. It also adds food values to item tooltips and hunger/saturation/exhaustion info to the debug screen (F3).

#### :ShieldCheckIcon: Durability Viewer

Displays your equipped armor pieces with their remaining durability right above the hotbar, so you know exactly when it is time to repair before your gear breaks mid-fight.

Press **H** to show or hide the display - see [Keybinds and Controls](/wiki/keybinds-and-controls).

![Durability Viewer showing armor around the hotbar](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/durability-viewer/armor-hotbar.webp "Armor durability displayed around the hotbar")

#### :HeartbeatIcon: Health Indicator TXF

Adds a compact damage indicator to the HUD, letting you keep an eye on your health at all times without looking away from the action.

![Health Indicator TXF on the HUD](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/health-indicator/hud.webp)

#### :LightbulbFilamentIcon: Lighty

Renders a colored overlay on block surfaces showing whether mobs can spawn there - green means safe, red means a mob could appear. Indispensable for lighting up bases and mob-proofing your builds. Toggle the overlay with **L**.

:carouselStart:
![Lighty overlay highlighting spawn-safe surfaces in a cave](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/lighty/caves.webp)
![Lighty number mode showing raw light levels](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/lighty/number-mode.webp)
![Glow lichen naturally blocking spawns under Lighty overlay](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/lighty/glow-lichen.webp)
:carouselEnd:

#### :WifiHighIcon: Ping View

Shows each player's ping as a number in the tab list, so you always know who is lagging - useful when playing on servers.

:carouselStart:
![Ping View showing player ping in the tab list](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/ping-view/tab-list-1.webp)
![Alternative Ping View tab list display](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/ping-view/tab-list-2.webp)
![Ping View configuration screen](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/ping-view/config.webp)
:carouselEnd:

### :BasketIcon: Items & Inventory

Better ways to browse items, recipes and containers.

#### :BookOpenIcon: Just Enough Items

The classic recipe viewer. Every item in the game is one keystroke away: open your inventory and the item list appears on the right. Click any item to see how it is crafted, press **U** (or right-click) to see what it is used in, and press **R** on a result to jump back to its recipe. Supports search by name and mod with `@` filters.

:carouselStart:
![JEI recipe interface showing a crafting recipe](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/jei/recipe-gui.webp)
![JEI potion brewing recipes](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/jei/potions.webp)
![JEI item list edit mode](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/jei/item-list-edit-mode.webp)
:carouselEnd:

#### :PackageIcon: Shulker Box Tooltip

Hover over any shulker box (or other container item) to preview its contents without placing it down. Great for organizing storage rooms and checking what is inside boxes in your ender chest or inventory. Multiple preview layouts are available in the config.

:carouselStart:
![Shulker Box Tooltip full preview mode](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/shulker-box-tooltip/full-preview.webp)
![Shulker Box Tooltip compact preview mode](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/shulker-box-tooltip/compact-preview.webp)
![Preview of other container types like bundles and chests](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/shulker-box-tooltip/other-containers.webp)
:carouselEnd:

### :ChatsCircleIcon: Chat & Social

Tools that make multiplayer communication nicer and safer.

#### :UserCircleIcon: Chat Heads

Shows the skin head of each player next to their chat messages, so you can tell at a glance who is talking even when several people chat at once.

![Chat message rendering with player heads and drop shadow](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/chat-heads/drop-shadow.webp)

#### :ChatCenteredDotsIcon: Talk Balloons

When you type in chat, your message also appears in a speech bubble above your character's head - perfect for communicating without opening the chat log.

:carouselStart:
![Talk Balloons speech bubble above a player](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/talk-balloons/balloon.webp)
![Dark and gold styled chat balloons](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/talk-balloons/qsmp-balloons.webp)
:carouselEnd:

#### :ClockCounterClockwiseIcon: More Chat History

Vanilla Minecraft only keeps the last 100 chat messages. This mod dramatically increases that limit, so you can scroll back through much longer conversations.

#### :ArrowUUpLeftIcon: Don't Clear Chat History

Normally your sent chat history is wiped whenever you relog or disconnect. This small tweak keeps it intact, so pressing up in chat still recalls everything you wrote.

#### :ShieldSlashIcon: No Chat Reports

Disables chat message signing, which makes your messages impossible to report through Minecraft's chat reporting system. Adds small status icons to the chat so you always know whether the server you are on is protected.

![No Chat Reports status icons in chat](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/no-chat-reports/chat-icons.webp)

![Unintrusive state of No Chat Reports](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/no-chat-reports/unintrusive.webp)

### :MountainsIcon: Visuals & Rendering

Squeeze more out of your graphics settings.

#### :BinocularsIcon: Bobby

Lets you see much further than the server's view distance allows. Bobby stores chunks the server has already sent you and keeps rendering them beyond the view-distance limit, effectively giving you a huge render distance on any server. Works great together with Nvidium (see [Performance Tweaks](/wiki/performance-tweaks)).

#### :SunIcon: Gamma Utils

Raises the game brightness far beyond the vanilla slider. Toggle fullbright instantly with **G** - perfect for caving without torch-spamming. The gamma slider goes up to 1500% and optional night vision and smooth transitions are available in the config.

:carouselStart:
![Comparison between 100% and 1500% gamma](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/gamma-utils/comparison.webp)
![Client-side night vision combined with shaders](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/gamma-utils/night-vision.webp)
![Optional gamma status effect shown on the HUD](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/gamma-utils/status-effect.webp)
:carouselEnd:

#### :CloudSunIcon: Smooth Skies

At high render distances the vanilla skybox shows a harsh line between the blue sky and the white horizon fog. Smooth Skies blends those colors into a clean gradient and also fixes sky rendering issues at low render distances.

:carouselStart:
![Harsh skybox color banding without Smooth Skies](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/smooth-skies/without.webp)
![Clean sky gradient with Smooth Skies enabled](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/smooth-skies/with.webp)
![Skybox and fog blending smoothly in a foggy forest](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/smooth-skies/foggy-forest.webp)
:carouselEnd:

### :LightningIcon: Loading & Stability

Get into your world faster and survive crashes gracefully.

#### :SignOutIcon: Fast Quit

Quitting a world used to freeze the game until the save finished. With Fast Quit the save runs in the background while you return straight to the main menu - you can even rejoin the same world immediately.

#### :SkipForwardIcon: EpicForceCloseLoadingScreen

Cuts the "Loading terrain..." screen the instant your world is ready instead of waiting for the animation, shaving seconds off every single world join.

#### :HourglassIcon: Remove Reloading Screen

Resource pack reloads normally lock up the whole screen with a loading overlay. This mod makes the reload happen behind a translucent overlay so you can keep watching your game while packs load.

#### :BugIcon: Not Enough Crashes

When the game crashes, you no longer lose everything. Instead of dumping you to the launcher, Not Enough Crashes catches the error, lets you return to the title screen (or straight back into your world) and keeps playing. It also produces detailed crash reports that point at the offending mod.

### :UsersThreeIcon: Account & Online

Accounts, friends and playing together.

#### :SealCheckIcon: Auth Me

If your Microsoft session expires, Auth Me lets you re-authenticate your account from inside the game - including offline-mode accounts - without restarting Minecraft or fiddling with the launcher.

#### :SparkleIcon: Essential

An all-in-one social layer: add friends, send DMs, host your singleplayer worlds for others to join (see [World Hosting](/wiki/world-hosting)), manage skins with the wardrobe, take and share enhanced screenshots, and customize your look with free cosmetics.

:carouselStart:
![Essential world hosting - invite friends to your world](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/essential/world-hosting.webp)
![Essential social menu with DMs and group chats](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/essential/social-menu.webp)
![Screenshot preview with quick actions](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/essential/screenshot-preview.webp)
![Picture browser for viewing and sharing screenshots](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/essential/picture-browser.webp)
![Outfits library inside the wardrobe](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/essential/outfits-library.webp)
![Custom Essential main menu](/smc/assets/content/mods/qol/essential/custom-main-menu.webp)
:carouselEnd:

### :MapTrifoldIcon: Map & Navigation

Never get lost again.

#### :MapTrifoldIcon: VoxelMap

A full mapping suite: a minimap in the corner of your screen, a fullscreen world map (**M**), and unlimited waypoints (**N**) that render in-world so you can navigate home, to that village, or to your friend's base. Zoom the minimap with **Z** and toggle the fullscreen map with **X**.

More keybinds can be found in [Keybinds and Controls](/wiki/keybinds-and-controls).

title: World Hosting
author: 5e8a
summary: Guide on how to play your Minecraft world with friends.
content:
## :UsersIcon: Adding a friend

Add your friend using [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential).

In Main Menu on the right side click Social > Add friend > your friend's username > Add

Then your friend needs to accept invitation.

## :HouseIcon: Hosting a world

**Method 1** - To host a world, click 'Host' in the main menu, select world you want to host, set desired options, click next and invite your friend from the list, and click 'Host World', then your friend have to accept the invitation and will join your world.

**Method 2** - Open your world, pause the game, click 'Invite', set desired options, click next and invite your friend from the list and click 'Done', then your friend have to accept the invitation and will join your world.
